description: List what is stored, newest first, with a short preview of each entry and its item_id. REQUIRES A KEY (or a sandbox_key from start_sandbox). Omit namespace to list your namespaces instead. Use the item_id with update_memory or forget. Read-only.

sandbox_key.description: Optional. A temporary key from start_sandbox, for trying without an account.

name: list_memories

outputSchema.description: With a namespace: a page of entries. Without: 'namespaces' only.

title: List stored memory
